_readme: DEVELOPER FILE - this is the ONLY file you need to edit to update the website's Donation Board. Add one { "name": "...", "amount": 0 } object per donation inside the "donors" list (comma between entries, no comma after the last one). Save, deploy/refresh and the board updates. Optional per-entry keys: "message" (short note shown under the name) and "date" (any text, e.g. "2026-11-20"). Top-level options: "currency" = symbol shown before amounts, "sort" = "amount" (highest first) or "latest" (newest entries at the top = bottom of this file first), "showTop" = how many rows to show before the 'Show all' button. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
